2608.08146.title: Long SKILL Compliance as Logical Reasoning: Closure-Grounded Detection with Scaling-Guided On-Policy Distillation
2608.08146.paper_summary: The increasing complexity of enterprise business scenarios has promoted the widespread adoption of long SKILL documents in agent systems, posing new challenges for compliance detection: large models incur substantial inference costs, while small models may fail to maintain detection accuracy. To address this gap, we propose SkillCDG, a graph-based framework for long SKILL compliance detection. SkillCDG represents complex business policies as a two-layer constraint dependency graph, where the upper layer indexes SKILL descriptions for scenario routing and the lower layer captures dependencies among atomic constraints within each SKILL. During inference, two-level retrieval followed by dependency closure supports compliance judgment and source traceability. We comprehensively evaluate the framework on three enterprise datasets and two controlled public benchmark variants. Experimental results demonstrate that SkillCDG outperforms baseline methods by up to 12.8 percentage points in detection F1 score, while reducing token consumption by a maximum 64.3\%. Moreover, we further investigate the inherent relationships among policy-graph complexity, model scale, and detection performance. Comparative experiments conducted on four checkpoints from a single model family validate a concise and effective scaling trend: end-to-end detection correctness exhibits a complexity-differentiated scaling pattern, and the complexity metric derived from the constraint dependency graph can effectively quantify instance difficulty and the performance improvement potential of models. Leveraging this insightful scaling trend, we conduct adaptive training sample selection and adopt on-policy distillation to efficiently enhance the compliance detection capability of small-scale models.
2608.08146.paper_summary_zh: 企業商業場景日益複雜，促進了代理系統中長SKILL文件的廣泛採用，這對合規檢測提出了新的挑戰：大型模型會產生可觀的推理成本，而小型模型可能無法維持檢測準確性。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了SkillCDG，一種基於圖的長SKILL合規檢測框架。SkillCDG將複雜的商業政策表示為二層約束依賴圖，其中上層索引SKILL描述以進行場景路由，下層捕捉每個SKILL內原子約束之間的依賴關係。在推理過程中，兩級檢索隨後進行依賴閉合，以支持合規判斷和來源可追溯性。我們在三個企業數據集和兩個受控公共基準變體上全面評估了該框架。實驗結果顯示，SkillCDG在檢測F1分數上比基準方法高出最多12.8個百分點，同時將標記消耗減少最多64.3%。此外，我們進一步研究政策圖複雜性、模型規模和檢測性能之間的內在關係。在單一模型系列的四個檢查點上進行的比較實驗驗證了一個簡潔而有效的擴展趨勢：端到端檢測正確性顯示出複雜性區分的擴展模式，而從約束依賴圖中導出的複雜性度量能有效量化實例難度和模型性能提升潛力。利用這一深刻的擴展趨勢，我們進行了自適應訓練樣本選擇，並採用了政策蒸餾，以有效提升小型模型的合規檢測能力。
